name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-smart-support-request
title: Smart Support Request
shortDescription: Mock IT support form with optional WebMCP draft filling, explicit human review, and in-memory receipts. No real tickets are submitted.
longDescription: A React and SPFx support form exposing an optional draft-only browser WebMCP tool. Structured arguments are validated atomically, each web part has its own tool lifecycle, and draft changes invalidate human review.

Manual entry works without WebMCP or an AI provider. Submission creates only an in-memory mock receipt; no list, backend, or API permissions are required. Includes a standalone local preview, Edge tests, and an Edge/WebMCP Explorer/Ollama setup guide.
